RESULT, null-calibrated against size-matched random gene sets on each platform: the OCCUPANCY-DERIVED PPARγ target set (ChEA ChIP-PET) is SET-SPECIFIC UP on BOTH readable EMC series (p_emp 0.0005 / 0.0005) and the KO_UP FALSIFIER is SET-SPECIFIC DOWN on BOTH (p_emp 0.041 / 0.0035) — the pattern an engaged receptor predicts. ⛔ CEILING: the ADIPOGENESIS PROCESS PROXY is also set-specific UP on both and shares 44 genes (23% of the smaller set) with the ChEA arm, so PPARγ target output CANNOT be separated from an adipogenic differentiation component in these data. ⚠ The KO_DOWN/OE_UP 'disagreement' this row inherited is NOT biological: the two arms share 16 genes of 206/269 (Jaccard 0.035) and are effectively different gene sets. ⚠ This is an ACTIVITY reading and says nothing about the DIRECTION of pharmacological intervention, whose one home remains research/manuscripts/pparg-direction-emc.md §6. ⛔ THIS ROW IS NO LONGER BLOCKED BY BLK-NO-EMC-DATA.
map_edits_required.reason: The row's own `blocked_by: [BLK-NO-EMC-DATA]` was wrong as stated: data existed, had been read, and the missing piece was a calibration that costs nothing. It has now been run. CLAUDE.md §0: 'blocked' is a claim that needs evidence and is usually wrong.

map_edits_required.anchor: ⚠ Scoped: the DIRECTION is unresolved, not refuted
map_edits_required.current_text: ⚠ Scoped: the DIRECTION is unresolved, not refuted — in EMC the fusion turns PPARG on, so an agonist may be redundant. An EMC expression read settles it either way.
map_edits_required.proposed_text: ⚠ Scoped: the DIRECTION is unresolved, not refuted. ⛔ TWO CORRECTIONS AND ONE MEASUREMENT. (1) The redundancy clause is WITHDRAWN — it is not in the source it cited and Filion et al. argue the opposite (research/manuscripts/pparg-direction-emc.md §3); it survives here in a field the §3 withdrawal did not reach. (2) 'An EMC expression read settles it either way' is FALSE AS WRITTEN: a read of receptor ABUNDANCE settles nothing, because abundance is already measured, and a read of ACTIVITY settles it only when calibrated against a size-matched null on the same platform — a raw delta of +0.33 with t=3.16 lands INSIDE that null band on GPL3290. (3) ⭐ THE ACTIVITY READ HAS NOW BEEN TAKEN (2026-08-07, run 31200817686): PPARγ target genes ARE co-ordinately higher in EMC than in comparator sarcomas beyond a size-matched random set, on both platforms, with the knockout-opposite arm moving the other way — and the same data cannot separate that from an adipogenic differentiation programme. One home: research/manuscripts/nr4a3-fusion-transcriptional-output.md §3.
map_edits_required.reason: A withdrawn premise left standing in a second field, plus a feasibility claim that overstates what an expression read can do. Both are quotable as written.

map_edits_required.proposed_text: Register FOUR new evidence items, all read from retrieved full text or abstract: EV-BRENCA-2019 (PMID 31020999, PMCID PMC6766969, doi 10.1002/path.5284 — ChAP-qPCR showing EWSR1::NR4A3 binds a SEMA3C NBRE-like site in human cells and TAF15::NR4A3 does not; the only chromatin-binding assay with the EWSR1 chimera in a human background); EV-KIM-2016-ENO3 (PMID 26310886, doi 10.1002/mc.22384 — EMSA + ChIP + luciferase for TFG::NR4A3 on the human beta-enolase promoter; ⚠ the fusion assayed is TFG, not EWSR1); EV-HALLER-2019-ACICC (PMID 30664630, PMCID PMC6341107 — NR4A3 ChIP-seq in three human AciCC tumours; processed data Zenodo doi 10.5281/zenodo.1483691 OPEN, raw EGA EGAS00001002795 controlled; ⚠ NATIVE NR4A3 by enhancer hijacking, NOT a fusion); EV-FILION-2005-PLAGL1 (PMID 16112421 — PLAGL1 DOWN-regulated by EWS/NOR1 and in six EMC tumours; the only published DOWN direction and therefore the directional falsifier for every EMC expression panel).
map_edits_required.reason: Four primary sources the graph does not hold, three of which are the entire mechanistic basis of the fusion's transcriptional output and one of which is the only accession-bearing cistrome anywhere near this question.
